data.current_description: Returns availability and registration data for a domain. Sources: RDAP when the TLD has a registered server, WHOIS port 43 for curated registries, DNS delegation check otherwise. Anonymous callers are limited to 5 requests/minute and 50/day per IP.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve domain availability and registration data
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves comprehensive availability and registration data for a specified domain. The operation queries multiple authoritative sources in order: RDAP (if available for the TLD), WHOIS port 43 (for curated registries), or DNS delegation checks (as fallback). Returns a DomainLookup object containing registration status, registrar information, nameservers, and other domain metadata. Rate limits apply: anonymous requests are limited to 5 requests/minute and 50/day per IP address. Authenticated requests with an API key consume quota based on your plan (500 monthly on Free, 10000 on Pro, reset on the 1st UTC).
